cards.title: Bulleted lists
cards.body: `<ul>` makes a bulleted list. Each item goes in its own `<li>`.

hi.title: Bullet wali lists
hi.body: `<ul>` bullet wali list banata hai. Har item apne `<li>` mein jaata hai.

cards.title: Numbered lists
cards.body: Swap `<ul>` for `<ol>` and the items get numbers instead of bullets.

hi.title: Number wali lists
hi.body: `<ul>` ki jagah `<ol>` likho, toh items ko bullets ki jagah numbers milte hain.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: One item does not show as a bullet point. Which line?

bug.fix:
Everything inside `
    ` should be a list item. Line 3 should be `
  • Bread
    • `.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Ek item bullet point ki tarah nahi dikhta. Kaunsi line?
hi.fix:
`
    ` ke andar sab kuch list item hona chahiye. Line 3 `
  • Bread
    • ` honi chahiye.

check.question: Which tag holds one item of a list?
check.explanation: `<li>` is one list item. `<ul>` holds the whole list, and `<item>` is not an HTML tag.

hi.question: Kaunsa tag list ka ek item rakhta hai?
hi.explanation: `<li>` ek list item hai. `<ul>` poori list rakhta hai, aur `<item>` koi HTML tag nahi hai.

exercise.prompt: Make a heading `Shopping list` and a bulleted list with at least three items.
exercise.promptHi: `Shopping list` heading banao aur kam se kam teen items wali bullet list.
exercise.starterCode: <!-- a heading, then a ul with three li items -->
